Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代，孟子跟孟母住在墓地的旁边。可是孟母注意，住在墓地的旁边影响孟子。他常常跟朋友们祭拜玩，所以孟母决定他们会搬家。这次，他们住在城市里的商店的旁边，从早到晚很吵。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代，孟子跟孟母住在墓地的旁边：在古代，better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 可是孟母注意：注意到，注意action vs.注意到result
- 他常常跟朋友们祭拜玩：祭拜着玩儿，V.着玩儿 do something just for fun
- 所以孟母决定他们会搬家：决定搬家
- 从早到晚很吵：都很吵

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代：在古代，A time noun used as a narrative time adverbial normally takes 在.
2. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟母决定他们会搬家：孟母决定搬家，After 决定, use a zero form when the person deciding is also the person carrying out the action; repeating a new subject is unnecessary.
3. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 孟母注意：孟母注意到了，注意到 uses 到 as a resultative complement for noticing something, and 了 marks this noticing as a completed discovery.
4. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 祭拜玩：祭拜着玩，Use 着 when the first action continues as the accompanying way in which someone does another action.

items.reason: The teacher requires 在 before 古代 when it is used as the narrative time adverbial.
决定 should directly take 搬家 here, without repeating a new subject and 会.
注意 means paying attention, whereas 注意到 expresses the result of noticing; adding 了 is also grammatical in this completed narrative event.
祭拜着玩 is a correct 着-structure for doing the worshipping just for fun.
